name: Personal Comm Implant
text: A subdermal communicator wired to your aural nerves and jaw. Lets you send and receive comm messages silently, without holding a device. Occupies your throat/ears system.

name: Personal Comm Unit
text: Standard personal communicator for audio and video messages. 1 mile terrestrial range or access to planetary communication networks.

name: Personal Grav Anchor
text: A belt that locally manipulates gravity. While invested, you ignore difficult terrain caused by low or zero gravity, and you can activate it to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for 1 minute once per day.

name: Prosthetic Limb
text: A fully articulated synthetic arm or leg that functions as well as the original. Restores function lost to injury and resists being disarmed. Occupies an arm or leg system.

name: Reflex Augmentation
text: Engineered nerve clusters quicken your reactions. You gain a +1 item bonus to initiative rolls. Occupies your spinal column system.

name: Regeneration Band
text: A pulsing biotech bracelet. While invested, when you rest for 10 minutes you regain Hit Points equal to your level. Once per day, you can activate it to gain fast healing 5 for 1 minute.

name: Ring of Energy Resistance (Minor)
text: A band etched with warding sigils. Choose an energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) when invested; you gain resistance 5 to that energy type.

name: Shock Grenade Mk 1
text: Releases an electromagnetic pulse dealing 1d8 electricity damage in a 10-foot burst (Reflex half). Especially effective against robots and powered armor.

name: Silver (Standard-grade Object)
text: Refined alchemical silver. Silver weapons overcome the resistances of many undead and creatures vulnerable to silver.

name: Smoke Grenade
text: Creates a 10-foot radius cloud of opaque smoke for 1 minute or until dispersed by strong wind. Creatures inside are concealed.

name: Solar Weapon
text: A martial melee weapon forged from the essence of stars, manifesting in a free hand. It deals 1d8 of your choice of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage. At 1st level choose up to two of: disarm, free-hand, grapple, nonlethal, parry, shove, sweep, trip, versatile — or instead take reach, or two-hand 1d10. Improve its damage with solarian crystals.

name: Speed Suspension
text: Servo-assisted leg replacements with reinforced shock absorbers. Your land Speed increases by 10 feet. Occupies both leg systems.

name: Spell Gem (1st Rank)
text: A crystalline matrix storing a single 1st-rank spell. As long as you can cast spells, you can Activate the gem to cast the stored spell once, after which the gem is depleted.

name: Sprayflesh
text: Pressurized canister of synthetic skin and coagulants. Spray on wounds as an Interact action to restore 1d6 HP and stabilize bleeding.
